newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Alpha sees '97 sales up, plans expansion.
newsitem.headline: Alpha sees '97 sales up, plans expansion.

text.p: South African cement manufacturer Alpha Ltd said on Tuesday it was forecasting a slight increase in earnings and a considerable improvement in pre-tax profits in 1997 amid expected higher sales volumes.
It said it saw stronger demand for cement and ready-mix concrete this year in line with higher gross domestic fixed investment forecasts for civil construction work.
"With higher sales volumes, the group is forecasting a slight increase in earnings and a considerable improvement in profit before tax and cash flow in 1997," the company said in a statement.
It said there were also signs that low cost housing delivery would gain momemtum this year and Alpha had positioned itself to supply its products into the emerging sector of this market.
The firm added that it would meet an expected increase in demand for cement by announcing plans to enlarge its production capacity later in the year.
It gave no specific details on the expansion.
A new cement product range is also to be introduced in the near future, Alpha said.
